pathAssistantSteps.info: The case cannot or will not be solved. This is not the right selection if the customer is unhappy with our response. Rather it is that we cannot provide a good answer to the problem e.g. Perhaps the original case raiser is unresponsive.
We have solved the case. Time to assess whether the interaction was a positive interaction for the customer.

This is the triage stage make sure the basics of the case are checked:

• Is it in the right queue?

• What is the user type? Have we checked for connected opportunities?

• Impact assessed and priority proposed

Assign to a team member.
The case should only be waiting with customer if you have emailed or contacted the customer in another way.

Your case is in this status because you are waiting for help from another team. In this stage:

• Track the team this is with

• Make notes about actions if they are outside of Salesforce

• Chatter with colleagues linking them to this case if they use Salesforce

Time to research and understand the task ahead of contacting the customer.

• How big do you estimate the task to be?

• How complex is the resolution

• Do you agree with the impact and priority assigned?

Who else might need to know about this case?

• Add case team members to keep them in the loop or collaborate

• Use chatter to notify others of activyty

Check the knowledge base and templates to resolve the case efficiently and consistently.
